name: mapping_whole_number_float_stays_number
description: put stores 42.0. The daemon's provider Value keys off the JSON text's own shape (a literal decimal point marks it Float, not the numeric value being fractional) — src/provider/mod.rs Value::from_json_at calls serde_json::Number::as_i64() first, which returns None for any number parsed from text containing '.', so 42.0 becomes Value::Float and round-trips over the wire as "42.0", never silently promoted to an integer literal. Every binding must decode it as a number equal to 42.
